notes.title: Bug Fixes (25.07.01)
notes.content:
Bug Fixes 

Fixed an issue where the character’s HP could drop below zero when a buff that prevents death for 7 seconds activates after reaching a certain HP threshold.

notes.title: Trophy count issue fixed when obtained (25.06.29)
notes.content:
Fixes
Duplicate trophy acquisition bug fixed
Fixed an issue where trophies were being awarded multiple times due to accumulation logic.

Improvements
Shop reroll shortcut key (Q) added
Added a shortcut that allows rerolling in the shop using the Q key.
